  {"step":5,"file":"libr/bin/format/bflt/bflt.c","function":"r_bin_bflt_free","line":75,"var":"o->hdr","code":"R_FREE (o->hdr);","note":"The rest of the object is freed, leaving the dangling relocation-list field behind in freed memory."},
